cards.name: Antique Armor Fossil

Ability: Protective Armor — As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, all of your Pokémon take 10 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play.

cards.warning: Colorless, so Dark Bell Confuses IT TOO — playing Dark Bell while this is your Active gives you a 50% chance to whiff your own attack. Its Run Errand Ability is also switched off by Team Rocket's Watchtower, which ~49% of the field plays.

cards.text: Shellnado Spin [P][P][P] 180. Shellnado Spin places 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon if this is damaged next turn.

cards.name: Academy at Night
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may put a card from their hand on top of their deck. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

cards.name: Ange Floette
cards.text:
You can put this card into play only if you discard a Prism Tower in play, and you can put this card into play during the same turn you play Prism Tower.
Each Mega Floette ex in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +150 HP.

cards.name: Area Zero Underdepths
cards.text: Each player who has any Tera Pokémon in play can have up to 8 Pokémon on their Bench.  If a player no longer has any Tera Pokémon in play, that player discards Pokémon from their Bench until they have 5. When this card leaves play, both players discard Pokémon from their Bench until they have 5, and the player who played this card discards first. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

cards.name: Battle Cage
cards.text: Prevent all damage counters from being placed on Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) by effects of attacks and Abilities from the opponent's Pokémon. (Damage from attacks is still taken.) You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

cards.name: Forest of Vitality
cards.text: Each player's [G] Pokémon can evolve into [G] Pokémon the turn they are played, except on their first turn.

cards.name: Fossil Quarry
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for up to 2 Item cards with "Antique" in their name and put them onto their Bench.

cards.name: Full Metal Lab
cards.text: [M] Pokémon (both players') take 30 less damage from the opponent's attacks.

cards.name: Granite Cave
cards.text: Steven's Pokémon (both players') take 30 less damage from the opponent's attacks.

cards.name: Jamming Tower
cards.text: Pokémon Tools attached to each Pokémon (both players') have no effect.

cards.name: Levincia
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may put up to 2 Basic [L] Energy from their discard pile into their hand.

cards.name: Lumiose City
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon and bench it. If they do, their turn ends.

cards.name: Perilous Jungle
cards.text: During Pokémon Checkup, put 2 more damage counters on each Poisoned non-[D] Pokémon.

cards.name: Spikemuth Gym
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Marnie's Pokémon and put it into their hand.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Factory
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, if they played a "Team Rocket" Supporter this turn, they may draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Watchtower
cards.text: [C] Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

cards.name: Acerola's Mischief
cards.text: You can use this card only if your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining.  Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to that Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon ex. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Amarys
cards.text: Draw 4 cards. At the end of this turn, if you have 5 or more cards in your hand, discard your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Anthea & Concordia
cards.text: You can use this card only if you have N's Darmanitan, N's Zoroark ex, N's Vanilluxe, N's Klinklang, N's Reshiram, and N's Zekrom in play.  During this turn, if your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by your N's Pokémon, take 3 more Prize cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Atticus
cards.text: You can use this card only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned.  Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: AZ's Tranquility
cards.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you moved a Pokémon ex to your Bench this way, heal 80 damage from that Pokémon.

cards.name: Bianca's Devotion
cards.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has 30 HP or less remaining. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Billy & O'Nare
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Then, if you have 10 or more cards in your hand, draw 2 more cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Black Belt's Training
cards.text: During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex.

cards.name: Boss's Orders
cards.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

cards.name: Ciphermaniac's Codebreaking
cards.text: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle, then put those cards on top of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Emcee's Hype
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 2 more.

cards.name: Eri
cards.text: Your opponent reveals their hand and you discard up to 2 Item cards you find there.

cards.name: Ethan's Adventure
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Ethan's Pokémon and Basic [R] Energy and put them into your hand.

cards.name: Explorer's Guidance
cards.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck, put 2 into your hand and discard the rest.

cards.name: Gladion's Final Battle
cards.text: Playable only as the last card in your hand. This turn, your Pokémon without a Rule Box do 80 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Gwynn
cards.text: Discard up to 2 Pokémon without a Rule Box from your hand, and draw 3 cards for each card discarded.

cards.name: Jacinthe
cards.text: Heal 150 damage from 1 of your [P] Pokémon.

cards.name: Janine's Secret Art
cards.text: Choose up to 2 of your [D] Pokémon. For each, search your deck for a Basic [D] Energy card and attach it. If you attached Energy to your Active Pokémon this way, it is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Jett
cards.text: Draw a card for each of your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play.

cards.name: Judge
cards.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck, then draws 4 cards.

cards.name: Lillie's Determination
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.

cards.name: Lisia's Appeal
cards.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, the new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.name: Misty's Vitality
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 4 Basic [W] Energy and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Your turn ends.

cards.name: Morty's Conviction
cards.text: Discard a card from your hand, then draw a card for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Naveen
cards.text: Draw cards until you have 5 in hand. Before drawing you may discard any number of cards from your hand.

cards.name: Rosa's Encouragement
cards.text: Usable only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent. Attach up to 2 Basic Energy from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.

cards.name: Rust Syndicate Grunt
cards.text: Usable only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn. Discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Salvatore
cards.text: Search your deck for a card with no Abilities that evolves from one of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon, even one played this turn.

cards.name: Tarragon
cards.text: Put up to 4 in any combination of [F] Pokémon and Basic [F] Energy from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Archer
cards.text: Usable only if one of your Team Rocket's Pokémon was Knocked Out last turn. Both players shuffle their hand into their deck; you draw 5, your opponent draws 3.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Ariana
cards.text: Draw cards until you have 5 in hand, or 8 instead if all your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket's Pokémon.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Giovanni
cards.text: Switch your Active Team Rocket's Pokémon with a Benched one. If you do, switch in one of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Petrel
cards.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Proton
cards.text: Usable on your first turn if you go first. Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon and put them into your hand.

cards.name: Adversity Policy
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has Weakness to your opponent's Active Pokémon's type, is in the Active Spot, and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Air Balloon
cards.text: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is [C][C] less.

cards.name: Amulet of Hope
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack, search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand.

cards.name: Babiri Berry
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Metal Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.

cards.name: Backtrack Badge
cards.text: Once during your turn, after you flip any coins for an attack of the Colorless Pokémon this card is attached to, you may ignore all results of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again.

cards.name: Binding Mochi
cards.text: Attacks used by the Poisoned Pokémon this card is attached to do 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

cards.name: Core Memory
cards.text: The Mega Zygarde ex this is attached to can use Geobuster [F][F][F][F] 350, which discards all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.name: Cynthia's Power Weight
cards.text: The Cynthia's Pokémon this card is attached to gets +70 HP.

cards.name: Heavy Baton
cards.text: If the Pokémon this is attached to has Retreat Cost exactly 4, is Active and is Knocked Out by an attack, move up to 3 Basic Energy from it to your Bench.

cards.name: Hero's Cape
cards.text: The Pokémon this card is attached to gets +100 HP.

cards.name: Maximum Belt
cards.text: Attacks by the Pokémon this is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex.

cards.name: Powerglass
cards.text: At the end of your turn (after your attack), if the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to it.

cards.name: Punk Helmet
cards.text: If the [D] Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack (even if Knocked Out), place 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Rescue Board
cards.text: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this is attached to is [C] less, or zero if its remaining HP is 30 or less.

cards.name: Tremendous Bomb
cards.text: If the non-Mega Pokémon this is attached to is Active and takes 240+ damage from a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, place 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon and discard this card.
